days.heading: Lisbon -> Palma, then old town reset
days.daycost: Est. ~$230 · meals, airport transfer, light sightseeing

facts.label: Flight
facts.valueHtml: LIS -> PMI · TAP/easyJet/Vueling corridor, TAP preferred

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Land, check in, La Seu / old town, pool or city-beach dip

days.note: Mallorca starts with Palma because it keeps the arrival day simple. No long drive after the island hop; save the rental-car beach base for Thursday.

spots.name: Palma old town + La Seu Cathedral
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · palmaIG · laseuIG · palmademallorcaFlickr

images.alt: Palma Cathedral and Royal Palace La Almudaina.
La Seu Cathedral in Palma de Mallorca.
Palma Cathedral in warm Mediterranean light.

spots.cost: Palma old town and Parc de la Mar are free. Cathedral baseline visit is roughly EUR10 adult, with children 9 and under free; terraces are a bigger EUR25 adult buy-up and not for under-9s, so the 8-year-old skips that version.
spots.climate: Mid-June Palma: warm, dry, and usually upper 70s to low 80s F. City stone gets hot after lunch, so do cathedral/old town early and move to a hotel pool or Cala Major/Portixol if the kids fade.
spots.saveHtml: Save Skip the terrace ticket with the 8-year-old; the outside, Parc de la Mar, old lanes, gelato, and a simple cathedral interior ticket are the better family value.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge One polished tapas dinner in Palma works here because the next four nights are beach-apartment simple.
spots.restoHtml:
• Family-restaurant shortlist — current Palma family lists surface pizza, Italian, and casual Mediterranean options
  • Can Joan de s Aigo — ensaimada, ice cream, hot chocolate; ideal picky-kid fallback
  • Pizza fallback — Palma has multiple easy pizzerias if tapas fails
spots.altboxHtml:
• Bellver Castle if the kids need ramparts instead of shopping streets.
  • Portixol waterfront for bikes/scooters and a calmer dinner walk.
  • Cala Major for a first Mallorca swim if the hotel pool is not enough.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Cathedral ticketsPalma with kids

days.heading: Palma morning, Soller / Tramuntana afternoon
days.daycost: Est. ~$260-$360 · depends on Soller train choice

facts.label: Choice
facts.valueHtml: Cathedral + old town, then drive or train to Soller

facts.label: Rule
facts.valueHtml: Do not overfill this day before the beach-base transfer

days.note: This is the Mallorca variety day: one Gothic city block and one Tramuntana mountain-port block. The old train is charming but expensive for four, so treat it as optional.

spots.name: Port de Soller + Tramuntana villages
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · sollerIG · portdesollerIG · tramuntanaFlickr

images.alt: Wide view of Port de Soller and its curved bay.
Historic tram in Port de Soller.
Aerial view of Playa de Muro and Alcudia Bay.

spots.cost: Historic Soller train official fare signal: Palma-Soller return EUR30, or Palma-Port de Soller train+tram EUR40. For four, that is EUR120-EUR160 before lunch, so this is the optional splurge unless the kids love trains.
spots.climate: Tramuntana: cooler than Palma in the morning, hot by the port after lunch. Roads are gorgeous but narrow; motion-sick kids do better with fewer village stops.
spots.saveHtml: Save Drive the loop instead of paying the full train+tram stack; park once in Soller or Port de Soller and keep the day short.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge Do the wooden train/tram combo once if the transportation itself is the attraction; it is expensive but memorable and eliminates mountain-road driving for the day.
spots.restoHtml:
• Port de Soller promenade — pizza, grilled fish, ice cream, and fries all within one waterfront walk
  • Soller market snacks — oranges, pastries, and simple sandwiches keep the train day flexible
spots.altboxHtml:
• Valldemossa only if the kids are done after one mountain village.
  • Deia viewpoint stop without the parking battle in the village core.
  • Hotel/pool afternoon if Tramuntana roads are slow or hot.

days.heading: Transfer to Playa de Muro / Alcudia
days.daycost: Est. ~$220 · groceries, beach shade, casual dinner

facts.label: Sleep
facts.valueHtml: Playa de Muro / Port d Alcudia · night 1 of 4

facts.label: Plan
facts.valueHtml: Apartment check-in, grocery run, first long sandy swim

days.note: The plan now stops touring and lets Mallorca do the job it was hired for: shallow sand, warmer water, and easy dinners.

spots.name: Playa de Muro + Alcudia Bay
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · playademuroIG · alcudiaIG · mallorcabeachFlickr

images.alt: Aerial view of Playa de Muro and Alcudia Bay.
Long sandy Playa de Muro on Alcudia Bay.
images.credit: Wikimedia Commons contributor · Google Images source

images.alt: Clear shallow water at Playa de Muro.

spots.cost: Beach is free; budget EUR25-EUR45/day for two loungers + umbrella when shade matters. Apartment-first lodging near Playa de Muro/Port d Alcudia is the budget gate: target $225-$300/night, walk away above ~$325/night.
spots.climate: Sea: Mallorca is usually about 72-75 F by mid/late June around Palma and the bays. Playa de Muro/Alcudia are shallow, sandy, and family-friendly, so this is the swim act Madeira cannot provide.
spots.saveHtml: Save Use a grocery breakfast, beach picnic, and apartment laundry. Four low-drama beach nights are cheaper than a full resort if you keep the lodging gate.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge One beach-club shade day or short bay boat trip is worth it if heat spikes or the 8-year-old needs an easier win.
spots.restoHtml:
• Port d Alcudia pizza list — Pizza Stellata / Don Vito style fallback if seafood loses
  • Alcudia family restaurants — Indian, tapas, burgers, and beach menus within a short drive
spots.altboxHtml:
• Hidropark Alcudia as the heat-wave rescue day, not a default spend.
  • S Albufera boardwalk for a cheap nature hour near the beach.
  • Alcudia old town walls at golden hour when the beach wind picks up.

days.heading: Formentor viewpoints, Pollenca, Alcudia walls

facts.label: Sleep
facts.valueHtml: Playa de Muro / Port d Alcudia · night 3 of 4

facts.label: Plan A
facts.valueHtml: Early Formentor / Mirador Es Colomer, beach recovery

facts.label: Plan B
facts.valueHtml: Pollenca + Alcudia old town if access rules or traffic bite

days.note: A scenery day without abandoning the beach base. Go early, take the view, then return to water before the afternoon gets crowded and hot.

spots.name: Formentor cliffs + Alcudia old town
spots.exploreHtml: PhotosIG · formentorIG · alcudiaIG · pollencaFlickr

images.alt: Cape de Formentor cliffs and blue Mediterranean water.
Cap Formentor lighthouse at the edge of Mallorca.
Aerial view of Playa de Muro and Alcudia Bay.

spots.cost: Viewpoints and Alcudia old-town walk are free. Budget parking, beach chairs if using Formentor beach, and extra fuel; seasonal access rules can push families onto shuttle/bus segments, so re-check before driving.
spots.climate: North cape: sunny, exposed, windy. Go early for viewpoints, then retreat to Playa de Muro for the reliable swim block.
spots.saveHtml: Save Treat Formentor as a half-day viewpoint loop, not an all-day remote beach mission with parking stress.
spots.splurgeHtml: Splurge A short Pollenca/Alcudia dinner after the cape is a better spend than forcing every viewpoint in one hot afternoon.
spots.restoHtml:
• Alcudia old town — tapas for adults, pizza/burgers nearby for kids
  • Port de Pollenca promenade — easy gelato and fries fallback after the cape road
spots.altboxHtml:
• Mirador Es Colomer only if road restrictions or crowds are ugly.
  • Pollenca steps for a town + view alternative without cape traffic.
  • Stay on Playa de Muro if wind makes the exposed north unpleasant.
spots.bloglinksHtml: Cap Formentor access checkUNESCO Tramuntana
